`final class VulkanTexture`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Texture`](/reference/bridges/texture/)<br/>
**Implements:** [`IVulkanTexture`](/reference/vulkan/ivulkantexture/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.render.texture` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanTexture.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/render/texture/VulkanTexture.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

A texture of Vulkan in device memory, uploaded through a staging buffer, with mipmaps built by linear blits.

## Description

A texture larger than the maximum size of the device throws an `IllegalArgumentException` that starts with `A texture of`.

## Learn more

- [What it is made of](/build/backends/vulkan/#what-it-is-made-of)

### create
